name: lead-quality-none-called
about: LQ3c: a young campaign whose leads nobody has called yet: no share of the called, no minutes to the first call, one lead that missed a hard requirement.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $284.25 and brought in 7 leads at $40.61 per lead, with a 1.4% click rate.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet brought in most of the day's leads: 6 leads for $184.50, at $30.75 per lead, with a 1.5% click rate.
Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 for 1 lead, so that lead cost $99.75. Its click rate was 1.1%, lower than Joliet's.

Over the last 14 days, Regional Class A — Joliet had 4 leads and nobody has called any of them yet. That means there is no wrong-number share and no time to first call. 1 lead missed a hard requirement, which is 25.0% of its leads.

The cohort from the week of 2026-09-28 had 40 leads: 20 were converted (50.0%), 12 applied and 5 were hired (12.5%). The week of 2026-09-21 had 38 leads: 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied and 4 hired (10.5%).
The cohort from the week of 2026-10-26 is too young to judge. So far it has 12 leads: 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied and no hires yet.
Spend so far in November 2026 is $612.30 on meta, with 28 days left in the month.
